description: One public X (Twitter) post by URL or ID from the JSON behind X's official embed widget: text, language, date, like and reply counts, edit status, reply-to, links, hashtags, mentions, photos and video (poster, duration, MP4 variants), quoted post, and the author (name, handle, blue check, label). Retweet, view and bookmark counts are not in this source. Timelines and search need X's paid API. Deleted or protected posts return 404. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
